record: records/32. Annexure-21  Depreciation as per UPERC Method_FY24-25.xlsx
note: NPCL's own depreciation workings, by vintage (assets before and after 1 April 2020) and by asset class, own assets and consumer-contribution assets, FY2020-21 to FY2026-27.  Compared at 4 decimals of Rs crore (Rs 1,000): workings keep unrounded figures.

blank_is_zero.why: NPCL's workings leave these cells blank where there is nothing (no additions, no grants, no retirement); its formulas (closing GFA = opening + additions − deductions − grants; closing acc. dep = opening + year − retired) read the blanks as zero

ties_to.why: net depreciation = own assets (both vintages) − consumer-contribution assets (both vintages); the true-up years only: the workings' FY2025-26 and FY2026-27 blocks roll the existing assets forward without the planned capitalisation, so they are not the projection
